description: ranx ranking reference inputs for hit_rate@1/5/10, MAP, MRR, precision, and recall. Each case uses one query q1. Relevance grades are non-negative integers; retrieval scores sort descending. Equal-score ties and empty rankings are covered.

cases.name: clean_top_ranked_relevant
cases.note: Two relevant docs; both ranked at the top by score. Ideal ordering.

cases.name: relevant_ranked_low
cases.note: Single relevant doc ranked last among 4 retrieved -> mrr = 1/4, hit_rate@1 = 0, hit_rate@5 = 1.

cases.name: tie_equal_scores
cases.note: Relevant dR and non-relevant dX have IDENTICAL scores. Captures ranx tie-breaking behavior explicitly (pre-flagged divergence point).

cases.name: tie_all_equal
cases.note: All three retrieved docs share the same score; one is relevant. Extreme tie case.

cases.name: empty_run
cases.note: Query has relevant docs in qrels but the run retrieved nothing for it. make_comparable=True governs handling.

cases.name: no_relevant_retrieved
cases.note: Run retrieved only non-relevant docs; the relevant doc dZ was not retrieved.
